content.value_statement: Poor storage planning creates clutter and wastes renovation space. This skill builds room-specific plans from household items, habits, dimensions, and proven cabinet strategies.
actual_capabilities: Builds a storage inventory from 25 common household item categories.
Plans storage across entryways, kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms, balconies, dining areas, and living rooms.
Suggests cabinet types for narrow spaces, corners, full-height walls, and hidden storage.
Provides shoe shelf heights and other documented sizing guidance.
Identifies ineffective storage habits, layouts, and unnecessary organization products.
Recommends practical storage tools without naming brands or sellers.
limitations: Does not replace an architect, structural engineer, electrician, or cabinet installer.
Cannot verify measurements, wall structure, building rules, moisture conditions, or installation safety.
Uses a fixed Chinese-language knowledge base and may not cover local products or standards.
Does not recommend specific brands, merchants, or products.

use_cases.title: Plan Storage Before Renovation
use_cases.description: Turn household items and routines into a room-by-room storage brief before cabinet design begins.

use_cases.title: Improve a Small Apartment
use_cases.description: Find vertical, narrow, corner, doorway, and underused spaces that can hold practical storage.

use_cases.title: Review Cabinet Proposals
use_cases.description: Compare a proposed layout against storage systems, item needs, access patterns, and common mistakes.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Storage Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan home storage. Ask about residents, rooms, important belongings, daily habits, and available cabinet space.

prompt_templates.title: Plan One Room
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan storage for my [room]. The room measures [dimensions], and I need space for [items]. Prioritize access and closed storage.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Cabinet Layout
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this cabinet proposal: [description]. Check item capacity, shelf heights, awkward access, wasted vertical space, and likely clutter points.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Whole-Home Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a room-by-room storage brief for [household]. Map every listed item to a location, cabinet type, access frequency, and planning risk.

output_examples.input: Two adults need entryway storage for daily shoes, seasonal shoes, coats, bags, and cleaning tools.
output_examples.output: Use a full-height shoe cabinet for daily pairs, a separate high-capacity zone for seasonal shoes, and closed sections for coats and tools.

output_examples.input: A small kitchen has crowded counters and no place for appliances.
output: Add a tall appliance cabinet with planned outlets.
Use drawers for frequent tools and shallow storage near service ducts.
Keep counters clear with selective wall storage.

output_examples.input: Review a wardrobe with equal fixed shelves for every shoe type.
output_examples.output: Replace equal fixed shelves with adjustable levels based on shoe height. Reserve dedicated space for tall boots and frequently used pairs.

best_practices: List belongings and routines before choosing cabinet sizes or locations.
Confirm all measurements and wall conditions with qualified local professionals.
Separate frequent, seasonal, bulky, and hazardous items by access needs.
anti_patterns: Do not add cabinets without mapping the items they must store.
Do not alter walls or utilities from general guidance alone.
Do not buy many organizers before fixing layout and capacity problems.

faq.question: What information should I provide first?
faq.answer: Provide household size, room dimensions, item categories, routines, existing storage, renovation stage, and any fixed constraints.

faq.question: Can it plan storage for one room?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers entryways, kitchens, dining areas, living rooms, bedrooms, bathrooms, utility areas, balconies, stairs, and narrow spaces.

faq.question: Does it provide cabinet dimensions?
faq.answer: It includes documented shoe shelf heights and selected examples. Confirm every final dimension with your designer and installer.

faq.question: Can it recommend storage products?
faq.answer: It recommends product types and selection principles, but it does not name specific brands, merchants, or products.

faq.question: Can I use its advice for structural changes?
faq.answer: No. A qualified professional must verify walls, utilities, building rules, waterproofing, ventilation, and installation safety.

faq.question: Does it support small apartments?
faq.answer: Yes. It emphasizes vertical space, full-height cabinets, thin cabinets, corners, door backs, wall storage, and multipurpose layouts.
